question: What is the value of (cottheta+cosectheta - 1)/(cottheta - cosectheta +1)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Suppose x = frac{{cot {{theta }} + cosec {{theta }} - 1}}{{cot {{theta }} - cosec{{theta }} + 1}}

⇒ (cot θ + cosec θ – 1) / (cot θ - cosec θ + 1)

⇒ [cot θ + cosec θ – (cosec2 θ - cot2 θ)] / (cot θ - cosec θ + 1)

⇒ [cot θ + cosec θ – (cosec θ + cot θ)(cosec θ – cot θ)] / (cot θ - cosec θ + 1)

⇒ cot θ + cosec θ [1 – (cosec θ – cot θ)] / (cot θ – cosec θ + 1)

⇒ (cot θ + cosec θ)(1 – cosec θ + cot θ) / (cot θ – cosec θ + 1)

⇒ cot θ + cosec θ

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
